answer: Once a quarter, each agent must prove it exists in one body: its operator appears in person at a verified venue, scans a fresh on-site challenge, and signs it with the agent key while the venue countersigns with a timestamp. A whisper cannot fake a body, and an opal is one stone, not a pile. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 trips — at $60 travel plus 3 hours each, that is $60,000 and 3,000 hours — while a wharf-side venue log records every visit for public audit.
